glorious - model i 2 ultra lightweight w.description: Elevate your gameplay like never before with the Model I 2 Wireless, the most comfortable gaming mouse in its class. Crafted with precision, this mouse combines an ergonomic design, ultra-lightweight construction, and a dedicated thumb rest, making it the perfect choice for gamers utilizing claw and palm grips. This next-gen mouse provides unrivaled comfort, allowing you to focus on your gameplay and achieve peak performance. The Model I 2 Wireless is a multi-genre mouse that caters to a wide range of gaming genres, including Battle Royale, MOBA, FPS, and more. Engineered with enhanced the BAMF 2.0 26K Optical Sensor and new Motion Sync technology, it ensures pixel-perfect tracking and flawless accuracy. Weighing a featherlight 75 grams, the Model I 2 Wireless offers lightning-fast speed and effortless maneuverability. The structural integrity has been vastly improved, while the redesigned buttons provide a satisfying click with each press, ensuring optimal comfort and responsiveness. With 9 programmable buttons at your fingertips, you can easily assign in-game actions, custom macros, and game-enhancing features to boost your gameplay. Tailor the shape of the mouse to your playstyle by swapping two of its side button positions with included alternate shapes; magnets make the process quick and easy. The Model I 2 Wireless provides an unrivaled gaming experience with its DPI Shift and Layer Shift features, allowing you to instantly adjust sensitivity and unlock a second programmable layer for even more customization. Enjoy extended gameplay with its impressive battery life and choose between 3 ways to play: 2.4GHz wireless for a strong connection, Bluetooth 5.2 LE for extended battery life, or wired mode for uninterrupted gameplay.
